listenings.text: Well, yes, the price is going to change a little after the first year. It depends on the numbers, more or less. We are going to talk about it before, of course. And it is not going to be a very big change.

Yes, it is. In March, we are going to adjust the fee. The adjustment is going to follow the inflation index, and this year it is about five percent. We are going to send you notice sixty days before. And the increase is not going to go above our cap of eight percent.
